name: Almamellék (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Almamellék (a white shield with a bunch of grapes and an apple bough) within a yellow wreath of grain, above the name ALMAMELLÉK in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
